title: Eventual consistency of analytics reads
statement: The system shall document that analytics-replica reads and traversals are eventually consistent, with no freshness bound, no cross-shard snapshot and possible one-sided or dangling edges.
rationale: PO decision: eventual, no freshness guarantee. Graph traversals make the inconsistency visible as edges whose other endpoint is missing or stale.

acceptance_criteria.text: User documentation for analytical queries states the absence of freshness and cross-shard snapshot guarantees and the possibility of one-sided or dangling edges.
Every analytical query result includes the per-shard replication positions it read from.
